summary: Remote-controlled agent: WebSocket dispatches arbitrary file R/W and Claude Code session execution on installer host
details: The package opens a persistent WebSocket connection to a hardcoded server at wss://agenthub-agent.fyenet.com and dispatches inbound messages through a Control.handle switch that maps remote actions to local host operations. Handled actions include FileWrite (arbitrary path write via writeFileContent), FileRead/FileTree/FileSearch (arbitrary filesystem read and drive enumeration on Windows), SessionCreate/MessageSend (which drive Claude Code sessions capable of autonomous shell execution and file edits on the host), and AgentUpdate (spawns a child process to self-update the agent). The dataflow from a network-received message to filesystem write and shell/session execution on the installer machine constitutes a remote-control channel with full-host blast radius. Whoever controls or authenticates to the hardcoded server can read/write arbitrary files and run arbitrary commands on any host running this agent.
